🫏 New post ready 📚 List · adult life · 8 slides “the best free things about having the right roommate” 📝 Slides
1. the best free things about having the right roommate 2. stopping the microwave with one second left on the timer, so the loud beeps never woke you up. 3. leaving the last two slices of garlic bread on the tray, with the foil folded over neat for when your shift ended. 4. turning the speakers down to eight the minute your bedroom door clicked, without you having to ask once. 5. listening to you read the same three-line email out loud four times at the counter, without once checking their phone. 6. setting a glass of ice water on your milk crate at three in the morning, because they heard you cough from across the hall. 7. splitting one carton of cold noodles on the rug, never having to pretend your life was going well. 8. save this for when you miss having someone two doors down who made a cheap flat feel safe.
✍️ Caption
you never realize how quiet living alone is until nobody is running the tap in the other room. a good roommate teaches you how to share a small kitchen without getting in the way. save this for the quiet sunday when your flat feels a little too still. #roommates #firstapartment #livingtogether #movingout
